To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make the entries below $a_{13}=1$ equal to $0.$

$$

\xrightarrow{R_{3}:=R_{3}-6R_{1}}\begin{bmatrix}10 & -4 & 1 \\ -26 & 10 & 0 \\ -68 & 31 & 0\end{bmatrix}=B
$$

Therefore, the elementary row operations are

$R_{2}:=R_{2}-2R_{1}$ and $R_{3}:=R_{3}-6R_{1}$.
